snippet.title: Birds of Impalitism | Demo Trailer | Vaporwave FPS Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
Birds of Impalitism is a PS1-inspired FPS puzzle game set inside an abandoned vaporwave shopping mall. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover a disturbing cult, and survive the secrets hidden within Palamus Mall

Steam Demo:https://store.steampowered.com/app/4736240/Birds_of_Impalatism/?beta=1

EXPLORE
Birds of Impalitism takes place in a abandoned mall once run by a capatalist cult. Learn how it fell apart, and the sinister truth of the cults purpose...

GAMEPLAY
SHOOT TO MOVE, BANISH ALL GHOSTS, DONT RUN OUT OF CD AMMO

SPEEDRUN
Level select lets you replay levels to practice and shorten your times!

#indiegame #vaporwave  #fps
